articles.summary: Recognized as Project of the Year by the Hawaii Society of Professional Engineers, Jacobs led the transformation of Lahaina’s wastewater facility into a sustainable water source for West Maui, supporting recovery, conservation and long-term water security.
articles.title: Award-winning upgrade strengthens Hawaiian island’s water future

articles.summary: For the second consecutive year, Jacobs has been ranked ENR's No. 1 design firm in the Airports category. The recognition reflects the company's work beyond major capital programs, spanning planning, airfield engineering, sustainability, digital transformation and operational readiness.
articles.title: Jacobs named ENR's No. 1 airport design firm for second consecutive year

articles.summary: Jacobs was selected by the Central Utah Water Conservancy District to provide engineering services for the proposed Strawberry High Line Improvement Project.
articles.title: Jacobs selected for critical Utah water infrastructure program
Jacobs reports strong fiscal third quarter 2026 results

articles.summary: Jacobs is strengthening its long-term commitment to the Southeast with a new Atlanta workplace designed to support collaboration, innovation and growth. The investment enhances employee experience while expanding the company's ability to deliver for clients across the region.
articles.title: Expanding our presence in Atlanta to deliver more

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by the Georgia Department of Transportation to provide engineering and design services across 27 counties in East Central Georgia, supporting critical transportation improvements that enhance mobility, safety and economic growth.
articles.title: Jacobs to drive transportation improvements in Georgia
